acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound and return trip segments in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip ticket is purchased with a promo code applied.
The system calculates the promo code discount amount for the return trip independently and includes it in the email confirmation payload alongside the outbound trip discount.
The system renders the promo code discount line item for the return trip in the same format and position as the outbound trip discount within the email confirmation template.

The system displays a promo code discount amount of zero (or omits the discount line) for the return trip when the promo code applies only to the outbound leg, without producing a rendering error or missing data placeholder.

The system correctly displays promo code discount amounts for both trip segments when multiple line items exist in the order with the same date range but different fromStation/toStation codes (e.g., AJ→UN and UN→AJ).
The system logs an error and continues processing the email confirmation without omitting the outbound discount when the return trip line item is missing promo code metadata in the order payload.
The system displays the correct total discount amount in the email confirmation summary as the sum of the outbound and return trip promo code discount amounts.
before.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation
before.title: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation

acceptanceCriteria: In mapDispatchPriceReport (submit-reservations.mappers.ts), when constructing the price report for a return trip dispatch element, the discount field is populated with the correct promo code discount amount calculated as discountPerUnit × lineItem.quantity — matching the logic in generate-staff-notes.mappers.ts.

In applyReportDiscountsService (apply-report-discounts.service.ts), return trip dispatches receive their proportional discount amount when a promo code applies to both legs, and the discount.amount.value is accumulated correctly without being zeroed or skipped for return dispatches.

In mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch (map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts), when dispatch.report.price.discount is present on a return trip dispatch, the discount.amount (including value and currency) is fully propagated to the sanitized output without being dropped or masked.
When a return trip has no promo code discount, report.price.discount remains undefined in the dispatch — no empty or zero-value discount object is injected for return trips without discounts.

When a promo code applies only to the outbound leg, the return trip dispatch report.price.discount is omitted (undefined) and no error is raised during Mozio submit-order or email confirmation rendering.
For multi-line-item return trip dispatches (e.g., AJ→UN outbound, UN→AJ return), each dispatch independently carries its own correct discount amount in report.price.discount.amount.value.
The total discount in the Mozio email confirmation summary equals the sum of outbound and return dispatch report.price.discount.amount.value values.
after.description: When a return trip ticket is purchased with a promo code, the discount amount is not displayed in the Mozio email confirmation for the return trip segment. The root cause is that the dispatch report price discount is not correctly constructed for return trip dispatches in the mapDispatchPriceReport → applyReportDiscountsService → mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch pipeline. The per-unit-then-multiplied-by-quantity discount calculation (already in generate-staff-notes.mappers.ts) must be consistently applied when building Mozio dispatch data for return trips.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code discount amount missing for return trip dispatches in Mozio email confirmation

notes: The root cause is in the dispatch price report construction pipeline: mapDispatchPriceReport initializes discount as undefined, applyReportDiscountsService applies discounts to dispatches, and mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch propagates the discount to the Mozio submit payload. For return trip dispatches, the discount amount is either not set or dropped during this pipeline. The per-unit-then-multiplied-by-quantity logic from generate-staff-notes.mappers.ts must be consistently applied when building the return trip dispatch's report.price.discount.
